dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing from the wide mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white skin tone; high median pixel intensity consistent with a mature or sub-adult phenotype.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, thin, linear markings visible on the right posterior-lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized linear striations on the right posterior dorsal plane, appearing as thin surface-level marks.
